profile_text.body:
GE HealthCare Technologies Inc. is a public company traded under the ticker GEHC and headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, with a CIK of 0001932393 on file. On its own site the company describes itself as a provider of digital infrastructure, data analytics and decision support tools that help in the diagnosis, treatment and monitoring of patients. It says it builds integrated solutions aimed at the industry's challenges and describes the future of healthcare as precise, personal and connected.

The site states that the company has over 130 years of delivering innovative solutions and that it tops the FDA's list of AI-enabled medical devices. It frames its work as helping hospitals and healthcare systems transform their operations and helping clinicians make therapies more accurate and effective. No individual AI products are named in the material available.

The company's recorded litigation exposure is in Illinois, with 339 cases. No specific lawsuits, products or MCP servers are listed for it.
